Ed25519 signature verification of ticket codes (@noble/curves or ticket-crypto)

exportCompliance.classification: Mass-market encryption item, ECCN 5D992.c, self-classified (EAR 740.17(b)(1)) because the apps use standard algorithms for data protection beyond the operating system. Standard algorithms only, no proprietary cryptography, no encryption for third parties.
exportCompliance.annualReport: A self-classification report to BIS and the ENC Encryption Request Coordinator is due each year by 1 February for items exported in the year before.
exportCompliance.france: Apple handles the French declaration with the documents uploaded in App Store Connect; nothing is added to the app.
exportCompliance.owner: pending owner and counsel: confirm the classification, upload the documents in App Store Connect, then set IOS_ENCRYPTION_COMPLIANCE_CODE in the EAS environment. Until then each upload asks the export question once per build.

apple.why: Organizers list events that may serve alcohol (infrequent or mild references); no other sensitive content. The app has no chat and no unrestricted web view.

answers.controlledSubstances: Yes, mild references (event listings may mention bars and alcohol)
answers.sharesLocation: No (approximate location is used for search only)
answers.digitalPurchases: Yes (tickets to physical events, paid in a web checkout)

3.1.3(e).answer: Tickets are admission to physical events, a real-world service. They are paid in the payment provider's web checkout opened from the app, not with in-app purchase. Virtual and livestream access is not sold in the app (those ticket types say "Buy on the web").
3.1.3(e).where: Discover > event > Continue to checkout; docs/plans/mobile.md P7-7

4.8.answer: Sign in with Apple is offered beside Continue with Google, an emailed code and a password.

5.1.1(v).answer: Account deletion is inside the app, after confirming identity and typing the email address.

4.2.answer: The app is a full ticket wallet with offline QR codes, search, checkout, transfers, refunds, calendar and notifications, not a wrapped website.

5.1.2.answer: No tracking. Notifications are asked after a first purchase or first opened ticket. Location only after "Near me".

play.targetAudience: 18 and over (ticket buyers); not designed for children
play.financialFeatures: None (no loans, no banking); payments happen on the provider's web page
